_comment: A Service made for the probe alone and shared with nothing, on the demo
organization the shop probe uses (isTestAccount, test-mode payments), like
the shop's `PROBE — do not buy` product. It is published because the probe
books through the same public path a customer does.
Why each setting is what it is:
timezone UTC    the probe builds the start time as an ISO instant from the
open-times answer; in UTC the slot's wall time IS the instant.
no approval     a booking without a seller decision is paid in full at
checkout (deposit = total, no balance), so one payment is
the whole of the money and one refund gives all of it back.
open every day  10:00 to 17:00, one booking per day, 1 to 60 days ahead. The
probe refunds and CANCELS what it books, which frees the date;
it books `daysAhead` out, moving on to the next open date if
`priceCents` / `currency` are asserted against the checkout's own quote.
